title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.71
summary: Fair 26-camera background startup plus fully verified frontend tests, robust session storage and WHEP timeout.
changes: Bound first cold-start HLS media wait to 20 seconds per candidate
Defer expensive ONVIF, encoder, alternate-profile and snapshot fallback attempts until each camera got a first chance
Keep four simultaneous starts, per-camera serialization and existing restart/backoff safety
Record queue wait and active startup durations by camera without credentials
Preserve legacy camera, recording, motion, HLS and fixed go2rtc broker behavior
Fix frontend initial sessionStorage import in non-browser and restricted contexts
Make WHEP SDP POST and response body bounded by a hard deadline
Run all legacy native node:test frontend suites separately from Vitest
Repair localized recording-storage translation and stale tests without disabling any tests
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.71
description: Two-stage 26-camera bootstrap, backend stream metrics and frontend regression fixes with independent Vitest/node:test runners.
releaseNotes: Direct upgrade from 2.20.32. 26 cameras receive a bounded 20-second first media attempt; failed profiles and snapshot recovery run in a second round after all cameras were admitted. Four start slots retained, with queue and active start time diagnostics. No database, camera settings, recordings, motion, patched go2rtc or .env changes. Frontend fixes: graceful storage-unavailable authentication token handling, hard timeout for WHEP SDP handshake, localization completeness for recording storage, corrected current behavior regression tests, and separate native Node test suites.
